newsitem.title: THAILAND: GF denies merger plan with GCN.
newsitem.headline: GF denies merger plan with GCN.

text.p: General Finance and Securities Plc (GF) said on Tuesday it had no plan to merge with G.C.N. Finance Plc, and denied press reports that it faced rising non-performing loans for the auto hire-purchase business.
GF Chairman Suchartchan Pravit said in a statement that his company and a GF-led commercial bank being launched this year had no plan to merge with G.C.N.
A Finance Ministry official told reporters on Tuesday that GF and SITCA Investment and Securities Plc had filed separate proposals to merge with other firms.

Suchartchan also dismissed as groundless Thai press reports that said GF faced growing problems from its auto hire-purchase business. He said the firm had stopped extending loans to the sector since 1992 and its outstanding loans to retail car buyers amounted to less than one percent of total lending.
